packageRules.description: Default every update to the `internal-dependencies` scope, so no update can reach a commit header with the empty scope the shared preset sets at top level. An empty scope is accepted by commitlint as the 'spans both shipped trees' case, so a dependency site that no other rule claims would silently assert a shipped change. This is sound rather than merely safe: images/** and templates/** are claimed by whole-subtree globs in scope-shipped.json, so any site reaching this rule is necessarily outside both shipped trees and is by definition an internal dependency. Extended BEFORE the shared presets so their own `github-actions` and `internal-dependencies` scopes still win where they match.
